nonblocking_finding_details.title: 1G '3x faster' regex uses Unicode multiplication sign only
nonblocking_finding_details.description: Group 1G's scoped ban for '3×' (CC-25) matches only the Unicode multiplication sign (U+00D7). An ASCII variant ('3x faster', '3X faster') would not be caught. The claim is currently removed from the Math page (which is now roadmap-labeled per CC-13), so risk is low. Noted by Review A (NB-1) and Review B (A7 narrow regex).
nonblocking_finding_details.recommendation: Optional: extend the regex to /3[x×]/gi in a future test-backfill. Does not block Phase 1 acceptance.

nonblocking_finding_details.title: b2b-solutions.ts coverage gap in 1B stale-date scan
nonblocking_finding_details.description: The 1B test scans locales/pages/products/ and app/[locale]/(marketing)/products/*/page.tsx for stale launch dates, but does not scan locales/components/products/b2b-solutions.ts. The 'New for SY2025' badge (CC-11) was fixed in commit 80231438 (badge → 'NOW AVAILABLE'), but no specific test guards b2b-solutions.ts against regression. The whole-source bans (1A/1D/1G) do scan b2b-solutions.ts via collectSourceFiles(), but 'New for SY2025' is not in their banned-literal lists. Noted by Review A (NB-2).
nonblocking_finding_details.recommendation: Optional: extend the 1B page.tsx metadata scan sub-test to also scan locales/components/products/*.ts. Does not block Phase 1 acceptance — the fix is in place and verified.

nonblocking_finding_details.title: A2 latent key mismatch in buildConsentIndex()
nonblocking_finding_details.description: phase-w3-claims.test.ts buildConsentIndex() keys consent proof by filename-derived subject (e.g. 'school-a' from 'consent-school-a.md'), while product-claim-helper.audit() looks up consent by the full claim.text. For a future published-case-study claim, a consent file named by subject would fail to match (missingConsentCount > 0). This fails closed (not a bypass) but is a usability issue when real case studies are reintroduced. Noted by Review B.
nonblocking_finding_details.recommendation: Resolve when Tier 2 [NEEDS-PO] real case studies are reintroduced (Phase 6 closeout). Does not block Phase 1 acceptance — current state has 0 published case studies, so the gate is satisfied vacuously-correct.
